Privacy Policy

Pools is intended for memecoins, which are assets created purely for entertainment, social, and cultural purposes. Their value is driven by market demand and speculation — not by anyone’s efforts or by any enterprise. No one is working to make these tokens valuable. Prices are extremely volatile and may go to zero, and these assets may not carry securities-law or other regulatory protections. Any use of Pools for an asset other than a meme coin is prohibited. CCA is available for other types of assets, subject to other applicable terms and conditions.
